build_tacotron2_model: build a Tacotron2 text-to-speech model with encoder, decoder, postnet, and optional latent audio encoder
run_tacotron2_inference: run inference on text inputs to generate mel spectrograms using the Tacotron2 model
review_attention_mechanism: review the Attention class with location-aware alignment energies for sequence-to-sequence decoding
test_audio_encoder_vae: test the AudioEncoder variational autoencoder that encodes mel spectrograms into latent distributions
refactor_decoder_loop: refactor the Decoder step-by-step loop with prenet, attention RNN, and gate layer for mel output generation
